The full integration suite didn't finish. Its background time limit stopped it at about 22:09 UTC, without an exit code.

- **How far it got:** 144 of 346 files had reported. No file failed beyond the five already in the handback.
- **What those five were:** four are explained: one I caused and fixed (re-run 14/14), and three passed when run alone (57/57). `response-validation.test.ts` (7 of 109 failed) has no known cause. Vitest only prints failure messages when the whole run ends, which this one never did.

I'm not restarting it here. At this host's load it would take hours more, and the time budget is spent.

I've updated the handback and its evidence log with these results.

What still needs to run on the merged tree:
- the full integration suite, including settling `response-validation.test.ts`;
- `pnpm test` with `C.UTF-8`;
- the 6 unit-web files (8 tests) that still failed when re-run alone.
